_comments: The Meetings application: a first-class app in Explorer beside Tasks (the meetings plan, § 5).

DefaultNavItems are ResourceType 'Custom' pointing at DriverClasses that @mj-biz-apps/tasks-ng registers with @RegisterClass(BaseResourceComponent, '<DriverClass>') in T4; Calendar is MemberJunction's view type and appears once A18 is in MJ next.
T1 ships the record; the resources it names land with T4 in the same minor release.

fields.Name: Meetings
fields.Description: Meetings and agendas: schedule one-off or recurring meetings, build agendas from templates, invite people and guests, run the live meeting, keep notes and file follow-ups as tasks.
